handbookNote: New York Real Estate Salesperson license exam. RECONSTRUCTED CONFIG: this track's original build session did not leave a local track-config/questionsDir on this machine -- the 294 live questions existed only in D1. For this pool-depth backfill pass (2026-08-31), the 294 live questions were exported directly from D1 and split by their existing 'topic' column into 17 bucket files under ny_re_salesperson_questions/ (Advertising/Broker Supervision & Office Operations 20, Agency Relationships & Fiduciary Duties 26, Commercial & Investment Properties 22, Condominiums & Cooperatives 14, Construction & Environmental Issues 16, Human Rights Law & Fair Housing 20, Land Use Regulations 12, Landlord-Tenant Relationships 16, License Law Violations & Disciplinary Actions 20, License Law & Licensing Requirements 18, Property Condition Disclosure 16, Property Management 14, Real Estate Contracts & Listing Agreements 18, Real Estate Financing 18, Real Estate Mathematics 14, Taxes/Assessments & Income Tax Issues 18, Valuation Process & Pricing Properties 12) to serve as inventory/style reference for backfill agents. Regulatory framework: New York real estate licensees are regulated by the NY Department of State, Division of Licensing Services -- governing statute is Real Property Law (RPL) Article 12-A (SS 440 et seq.), with implementing regulations at 19 NYCRR Part 175. A companion track, ny_re_broker (1238 questions, already built and backfilled in an earlier session this project), used the SAME statutory framework at broker level -- its local config at scripts/tracks/ny_re_broker.json contains independently-verified NY citations (RPL Article 12-A sections, NY Human Rights Law, etc.) that can be reused directly for this salesperson-tier backfill where genuinely applicable, since salesperson and broker share the same underlying statute. This track_registry entry (exam_question_count=75, pass_percent=70) reflects the currently-tracked exam mechanics. Bucket agents should independently verify current statute section numbers via live fetch of nysenate.gov/legislation (NY Real Property Law) rather than assuming figures carry over unchanged between salesperson and broker tiers. Price set at $29.99 (2999 cents) to match this project's standardized Real Estate track rate, consistent with ny_re_broker.json. Backfill new-question IDs use prefix 'ny_re_salesperson-deepen1-*', which will not collide with the original IDs already in D1.
